description: Non-intrusive voice quality analysis (Sevana PVQA) of an uploaded WAV file: predicted MOS (1-5) and the impairments found (low SNR, noise, dead air, clipping, clicks, echo, packet-loss artifacts, ...). No reference recording is needed. report_type "extended" adds the per-interval detector table.

channel.description: channel to analyze, from 0 (default 0); -1 mixes all channels

name: pvqa_analyze

impairments.description: detectors that fired, with their interval counts

detector.description: detector name, e.g. SNR, Echo, Click, DeadAir-00

intervals.description: number of intervals where this detector fired

excluded.description: intervals excluded from the score (silence, DTMF)

uncertain.description: intervals the detectors could not classify

is_silent.description: true when the file contains no signal

mos.description: predicted MOS (1-5); null when the file has no speech to score

mos_model.description: name of the learned MOS model that produced the score

columns.description: column names: Time, then one per detector, then Status

rows.description: one row per 0.68 s interval, values as printed by the analyzer

title: PVQA: voice quality of a recording
